newsitem.title: USA: ATEC converts converitble preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: ATEC converts converitble preferred stock.

text.p: ATEC Group Inc said Wednesday that shares of its outstanding Series D,E,J, and K Convertible Preferred Stock had been converted into shares of common stock.
The conversion will not hurt per share figures because the convertible preferreds had always been included in the calculation, the company said.

The company said also that it plans to explore listing on the national market system and it will no longer issue convertible preferred shares. It said it would let its existing warrants expire in February 1998.
After the conversion, ATEC has 29,827,679 common shares outstanding and a balance of convertible preferred shares representing 64,284 shares of common stock.
The company is a full service, authorized computer dealer and value-added reseller of enterprise computer products.
